description: Receives notification alerts and posts them to a Slack channel. Optionally resolves an email to a user mention. Passes alert data downstream for further processing.

config.label: API Token
config.description: Slack Bot User OAuth Token (starts with xoxb-). Created in the Slack App settings under OAuth & Permissions.

config.label: Channel ID
config.description: The Slack channel ID to post messages to. Find it by right-clicking the channel name and choosing Copy Link — the ID is the last path segment.

config.label: Mention Email
config.description: Optional. An email address to resolve to a Slack user mention and append to the message. Leave empty to send the message without a mention.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, API requests are simulated and no message is sent. Useful while wiring up the workflow.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the Slack server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing behind a proxy.
